Reestablish the deduplicated CSV data and write the backup using only allowed operations.

```python
unique_csv_data = list(dict.fromkeys(csv_data))
headers = 'Title,Artists'
rows = ['%s|%s' % (row[0], row[1]) for row in unique_csv_data]
csv_content = '\n'.join([headers, *rows])
backup_dir = '~/backups'
backup_file = f'{backup_dir}/spotify_library.csv'
directory_result = apis.file_system.create_directory(
    directory_path=backup_dir,
    access_token=file_system_access_token,
    recursive=True,
    allow_if_exists=True
)
write_result = apis.file_system.create_file(
    file_path=backup_file,
    access_token=file_system_access_token,
    content=csv_content,
    overwrite=True
)
print({'directory_result': directory_result, 'write_result': write_result, 'row_count': len(unique_csv_data)})
```
